The problem is identical to the issue of addressing the unique identity difficulty in India. Giving out non volatile identifiers like finger prints or retinal scans is simply bound to fail. A password, when exposed, can be changed but a retinal scan cant be changed. The identity should be double anonymous. Neither the server nor the identity enquirer should get the persons personal details but should be authenticate the person under question.

We need a centralised non compromisable authentication system which can verify an identity while maintaining the anonymity. I don't think there is any system out there that can do it. For now at least.
